verdict.rationale: Identity resolution is a fair question for a product-analytics platform like PostHog, so the axis applies. The evidence pack only mentions persons and person properties in passing, as in rollouts by person property or querying events and persons in SQL. Nothing documents an identify or alias call, cross-device identity stitching, or merging anonymous pre-signup events into an identified profile.

support.subject: As a developer, I can identify users across devices and merge anonymous pre-signup activity into their identified profile
